Cross
12kt Gold Filled Pen and Pencil Set
Vintage Century Series, Late 20th Century
This classic Cross writing set includes a ballpoint pen and a mechanical pencil, both featuring a 1/10 12kt gold-filled finish. The set showcases the slim "Century" profile with pinstripe engine-turned engraving and signature black conical caps. These instruments represent Cross's mid-to-late 20th-century production, noted for balanced weight and timeless professional design.
1/10 12kt gold filled construction with ribbed pinstripe texture
Set includes ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil (model 6603)
Original presentation box with instruction booklet included
Engraved "CROSS" branding on clips and upper barrels
Condition:
Very good condition with minor surface handling wear. Both pieces maintain a high-luster finish. The mechanical pencil appears functional; pen ink status is unknown. The original box is intact but shows a notable tear on the top right of the lid.

276411009.description: This listing includes three polished and cut septarian nodule specimens, also known as dragon egg stone, with sizes ranging from 1.85 to 2.25 inches. The assortment features a polished round palm stone, displaying a vibrant yellow calcite core surrounded by brown aragonite and grey matrix. Two oval-shaped pieces show a white crystalline web structure and internal crystal and mineral patterns. The stones exhibit brown, yellow, and cream coloration and show some UV reaction. These specimens are in good, display-ready condition, suitable for collectors or those interested in natural minerals.
